name: Holly Brown
source:
Holly Brown is a journalist trying to get [url=/c148150]you[/url] to speak about Dante's Enterprise and the commitments [url=/c148155]Father[/url] left behind. Her questions stand out from the accusations surrounding your return, but that does not make an interview with her safe. She is persistent, and you do not yet know what she is ultimately looking for.
